symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input; the worst-case time is measured as a function of it.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the length in bits of each input.

symbols.name: power-saving constant
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant equal to $2^{-182}$ that does not depend on $n$.
symbols.quote: The theorem also bounds its worst-case time by a constant times $n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$, with a fixed constant $\kappa = 2^{-182}$, so the multiplication bound is a claim about a fixed-tape machine.
